commands.name: docx

commands.name: xlsx
commands.description: Use this skill any time a spreadsheet file is the primary input or output. This means any task where the user wants to: open, read, edit, or fix an existing .xlsx, .xlsm, .xltx, .csv, or .tsv file (e.g., adding columns, computing formulas, formatting, charting, cleaning messy data); create a new spreadsheet from scratch or from other data sources; or convert between tabular file formats. commands.name: dataviz
commands.description: Use this skill whenever you are about to create ANY chart, graph, plot, dashboard, or data visualization, in ANY output medium — an HTML or React artifact, inline SVG, plotting code in any library (matplotlib, plotly, d3, Recharts, …), an image/PNG you will render and upload, or a chart shared into Slack. Read it BEFORE writing the first line of chart code, choosing chart colors, building a stat tile / meter / KPI row, or laying out a dashboard. Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Teaches a design-system-agnostic method: a form heuristic, a color formula with a runnable validator, mark specs, and interaction rules. A validated default palette is documented in `references/palette.md` — swap that file's values for your brand's. Triggers on: "chart", "graph", "plot", "data viz", "visualization", "dashboard", "analytics", "visualize data", "categorical colors", "sequential / diverging palette", "stat tile", "sparkline", "heatmap", "legend", "axis", "tooltip", "chart colors", "color by series".

commands.name: update-config
commands.description: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. ## What I found

The file actually had **24** errors, not 13. The 13 `TS18047` were the headline, but the acceptance bar is zero errors for the file, so I fixed all of them.

## The fixes

**The 13 `TS18047` ('db' is possibly 'null')** — `getDb()` returns `null` when `DATABASE_URL` is unset. Added the repo's existing guard after each of the 7 `await getDb()` call sites:
```ts
if (!db) throw new TRPCError({ code: 'INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR', message: 'Database unavailable' });
```
(same pattern as `server/governance/tenant-analytics-router.ts`).

**The other 11:**
- `createLogger('geometry-admin-router')` — registered the domain in the `LogDomain` union in `server/_core/logger.ts:224`. This is the only other file I touched; it follows the precedent of commit `b6ade3d` ("register the voice gateway's domain"). `LogDomain` has no exhaustive consumers, so widening it can't break anything.
- `z.record(z.number())` → `z.record(z.string(), z.number())`. The single-arg form was being read as the *key* type, giving `Record<number, unknown>` and cascading three assignment errors.
- `recordPreHook` was called with 3 of 5 args — supplied the real `shouldConstrain` / `constraintsInjected.length`.
- `recordPostHook(loopDetected, computeTimeMs)` had its arguments **swapped** against the `(computeTimeMs, loopDetected)` signature.
- The two advanced-neurocosmology hooks were passed a flat `Record<string, number>` where they need a `CanonicalEmotionalState`. Added a local `buildCanonicalState` helper mirroring the one in `server/governance/governed-generate.ts`.
- `evaluateAlerts(pre as any, post as any, sessionId)` — the function takes a single `AlertEvaluationParams` object and returns a `number`. Rebuilt the synthetic pre/post as properly typed `GeometryPreGenerationResult` / `GeometryPostGenerationResult`, moved singularity/phase-transition/invariant fields into `neuroAdvanced` where they belong, and read the returned count directly. This also removed the file's two pre-existing `as any` casts.

That last one exposed a live bug the casts were hiding: `syntheticPre` had no `computeTimeMs`, so `preResult.computeTimeMs + postResult.computeTimeMs` was `NaN` and the `compute_degradation` test alert could never fire. It now does.

## Verification

- Target file: 0 errors. No `@ts-ignore`/`@ts-expect-error`/`@ts-nocheck`/`any` in it, and nothing deleted.
- Repo-wide: 757 errors remain, all pre-existing in unrelated files (this repo is broadly untypechecked — `client/`, `drizzle/schema.ts`, `server/governance/*`, etc.). The head of the error list is byte-identical to the baseline I captured before editing, and no error references `_core/logger.ts` other than a pre-existing unrelated one about a missing `Logger` export.

One gap: I could not run a clean baseline diff or the router's tests — the sandbox refused `git stash`, `git worktree add`, and `npx vitest run`. I verified the blast radius by inspection instead: `LogDomain` is referenced outside the logger only once, behind a cast, and no file outside the router references `diagnosticGeneration` or `fireTestAlert` except two tests that only assert the procedure names exist.
